specs.IdRemoveObj::high_level_spec: high_level_spec With (sm: StableIdmanager) (m: VarIdmanager) (idnode: addr) Require manager != 0 && 0 <= id && id < 65536 && idmanager_query( idmanager_link(sm, idmanager_add(m, id), id, idnode), id) == true && store_idmanager(sm, idmanager_link(sm, idmanager_add(m, id), id, idnode), manager) Ensure idnode != 0 && &(idnode->link) != 0 && store_idmanager(sm, idmanager_remove(sm, idmanager_link(sm, idmanager_add(m, id), id, idnode), id), manager) * (idnode->id == 65535) * (idnode->link.node_prev == &(idnode->link)) * (idnode->link.node_next == &(idnode->link))
specs.IdRemoveObj::low_level_spec: low_level_spec With (sm: StableIdmanager) (m: VarIdmanager) Require manager != 0 && 0 <= id && id < 65536 && store_idmanager(sm, m, manager) Ensure (idmanager_query(m, id) == false && store_idmanager(sm, m, manager)) || (exists idnode, idmanager_query(m, id) == true && idmanager_contains(sm, m, id, idnode) && idnode != 0 && &(idnode->link) != 0 && store_idmanager(sm, idmanager_remove(sm, m, id), manager) * (idnode->id == 65535) * (idnode->link.node_prev == &(idnode->link)) * (idnode->link.node_next == &(idnode->link)))
specs.DoubleLinkListRmNode::remove_ready_membe: remove_ready_member With (task head : Z) (prefix suffix : list(DL_Node Z)) Require linklist_node == sched_link_of(task) && store_priority_ready_bucket( head, app(prefix, cons(sched_link_node(task), suffix))) Ensure linklist_node == sched_link_of(task) && store_priority_ready_bucket(head, app(prefix, suffix)) * store_node_self_linked(linklist_node)

specs.DoubleLinkListRmNode::remove_self: remove_self With (node : Z) Require linklist_node == node && node != 0 && store_node_self_linked(node) Ensure store_node_self_linked(node)
specs.DoubleLinkListRmNode::remove_member: remove_member With {A} (storeA: addr -> A -> Assertion) (head: addr) (a: A) (prefix: list(DL_Node A)) (suffix: list(DL_Node A)) Require store_dll(storeA, head, app(prefix, cons(Build_DL_Node(a, linklist_node), suffix))) Ensure store_dll(storeA, head, app(prefix, suffix)) * storeA(linklist_node, a) * store_node_self_linked(linklist_node)

blocker.message: The retirement VCs lost the old semaphore manager ID uniqueness across IdRemoveObj. Its postcondition only gives contains(old,id,idnode_2) and store_idmanager(remove(old,id)); remove filters all matching IDs, so post-wf does not recover old NoDup. A pre-VC model with two distinct semaphore objects carrying the deleted ID can return the other object ID node, leaving no ownership of the target sem ID field required by SemaphoreRetired. Preserve a pure old-manager NoDup/unique-node fact derived before the call, through deletion and retirement.
